method: content-based: one `git log --all -G <carrier_regex> --name-only` pass gives every path that ever carried or lost status text; every ref (heads, remotes, tags peeled, tree refs, governance refs) is enumerated; commit tips are inventoried with `git ls-tree` over those paths; tree refs with `git grep`; owner records are parsed and the obligation table is computed from them
